# Tau

> Tau is a timelapse recorder and editor for macOS and Windows. It lets you record your screen, camera, or both at once — then trim, add overlays, and export timelapses directly without external tools.

## What Tau is

Tau is a purpose-built timelapse app. Unlike general screen recorders (OBS, QuickTime) or video editors (ScreenFlow, Camtasia), Tau is designed specifically for the timelapse workflow: frame-interval capture, built-in editing, and one-click export.

It runs quietly in the background while you work, capturing one frame every N seconds. When your session is done, you open the editor, trim, optionally add a timer overlay or audio, and export.

## Who it is for

- Developers recording coding sessions as timelapses
- Designers documenting their design process
- Artists creating art timelapse videos
- Content creators making process videos for YouTube, X, Instagram, TikTok
- Anyone who wants to show their work in a compressed, shareable format

## Key Features

- **Frame interval recording**: Capture 1 frame every N seconds — not a sped-up full-rate video, but true timelapse capture
- **Screen recording**: Record your screen as a timelapse
- **Camera recording**: Record your webcam, USB camera, or iPhone (Continuity Camera, macOS only)
- **Multi-source**: Record screen and camera simultaneously in the same timelapse
- **Timer overlays**: Add stopwatch, clock, or countdown overlays with custom fonts and positioning — burned into the export automatically
- **Built-in editor**: Trim start/end points, attach audio
- **Multi-format export**: One-click export to MP4, GIF, or WEBM
- **Lightweight**: Designed to run in the background without slowing down your work

## Pricing

- **Solo**: €9.99 one-time payment — 1 device, all features, free updates
- **Pro**: €17.99 one-time payment — up to 3 devices, priority support, early access
- No subscription. No recurring fees. 14-day money-back guarantee, no questions asked.

## Platform support

- macOS (Intel + Apple Silicon)
- Windows

## Account & License

Users can create a free account at trytau.app to link their license key. Once linked, the account remembers the key for future downloads — no need to retrieve it from email each time. Sign in at https://trytau.app/sign-in. License keys are purchased through Polar and delivered by email at time of purchase.

## Comparison to alternatives

- **vs OBS Studio**: OBS records full video for streaming. It has no native frame interval mode — making a timelapse requires post-processing with FFmpeg or a video editor. Tau records at frame intervals natively, includes editing, and is purpose-built for timelapse.
- **vs ScreenFlow**: ScreenFlow is a full video editor for Mac ($149+). It can record your screen but has no frame interval mode. Export to GIF/WEBM requires workarounds. Tau costs less, is cross-platform, and is designed specifically for timelapse.
- **vs Loom**: Loom is a SaaS tool for async screen sharing — it records and hosts full-rate video. It is not a timelapse tool. Tau is a one-time purchase, offline, and timelapse-focused.
- **vs QuickTime**: QuickTime records full-rate video with no frame interval mode. Timelapse requires speeding up the video in iMovie or another editor. Tau handles the full workflow natively.
